title: Avro Lancaster HK773
memorial_details: Brass plaque with incised inscription in capital lettering below the badge of the RAF.
inscription: IN MEMORY OF THE CREW OF/ LANCASTER BOMBER HK 773 LS-W/ OF XV SQUADRON WHO LOST THEIR/ LIVES WHEN THE AIRCRAFT CRASHED/ IN THE NEARBY FOREST AT 11:00 AM/ ON 22 MARCH 1945 HAVING TAKEN/ OF FROM RAF MILDENHALL/ (Names)/ ALSO/ (Name)/ KILLED JUNE 1ST 1944/ A MEMBER OF A SISTEER CREW.
